title: Helping teams ramp and share expertise
scope: Coaching and onboarding alongside an enterprise-selling role.
collaboration: Solution architects, SDRs, newer sellers and customer success teammates.
decision: Turn repeated field questions into resources teammates can reuse, and coach alongside sales leadership so new sellers ramp on what is already working.
context: My enterprise sales roles included discovery, technical evaluations and helping new teammates learn the product.
contribution: I created product training for new hires at Darktrace and Truffle Security. At Truffle, I also coached SDRs and newer sellers and built discovery and proof-of-concept resources for the sales team.
execution: At Forcepoint, Darktrace and Truffle Security, I created discovery templates and co-wrote setup guides with solution architects. At Truffle, I also helped onboard teammates across sales, solutions architecture and customer success.
evidence: The career timeline describes SDR coaching and onboarding across customer-facing roles; confidential onboarding materials are not reproduced here.
takeaway: Good enablement reduces dependence on one person holding all the context.
reviewer: Pending human review of the CMS move
